subject: facet_wrap what controls if x axis values are always plotted

messages.author: 36ec1331d4d5918f
messages.subject: facet_wrap what controls if x axis values are always plotted
parts:
Hi,

When using facet_wrap with a number of facets that leaves some "columns" incompletely filled (i.e. there are plots missing on the bottom row), some examples show that the x tick marks and values are shown anyway, as in the first example of the user guide:

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/facet_wrap.html
d <- ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, price, fill = ..density..)) + xlim(0, 2) + stat_binhex(na.rm = TRUE) + opts(aspect.ratio = 1)
d + facet_wrap(~ color)
This figures show x tick marks and labels at the bottom of all three columns of plots, even though columns 2 and 3 are missing a plot on that bottom row.

But when I run the same 2 lines of code on my computer, the figure I get has x-axis tick marks and labels only below the first column.

I can see the usefulness of both behaviours, but how do we control this?

Further, a feature request: I would find very useful a 3rd behaviour where the the tick marks and labels would be placed directly below the bottom plot of each column, not always at the bottom of each column. I know we can get close to this with scales="free_x", but when all plots have the same x axis, this option introduces much repetition and wastes space that would be better used by the plots.

Thanks in advance,

Denis
